## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 6-fascicle sub-commentary on [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) Zhìyǐ's *[Guān wú liàng shòu fó jīng shū](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0073)* (T1750) is by [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) Zhīlǐ (960–1028), the great Northern-Sòng Tiāntái-school revivalist. It is one of the principal documents of the Sòng *Shānjiā* 山家 (Mountain-Family) Tiāntái lineage's Pure Land synthesis.
